We evaluate PopAlign on two alignment tasks and three well-recognized leaderboards: (1) Harmless-Base subset in HH-RLHF , (2) Helpful-Base subset in HH-RLHF , (3) AlpacaEval 2.0 , (4) Arena Hard , and (5) MT-Bench .

We define contrast accuracy as the percentage of synthesized response pairs where the oracle model correctly identifies and prefers the chosen response over the rejected one. Specifically, given a response pair (r+, r-) in the synthesized preference dataset, an oracle model is asked to select the preferred response.
We randomly selected 200 samples from the synthesized training set of PopAlign for the evaluation using GPT-4 and PairRM, a well-known off-the-shelf reward model.
For the alignment tasks, our evaluation is based on GPT following common practices . We compare each baseline with PopAlign to obtain a win rate.
